import pandas as pd

# First, let's get all station IDs to fetch network-wide data

# Time window: 2025-07-19 00:00:00 to 2025-07-22 00:00:00 (exclusive end)
query = text("""
SELECT station_id, datetime, pm2_5, aqhi, aqhi_level
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-07-19 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-22 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime, station_id
""")
aq_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Air quality data rows: {len(aq_df)}")
print(aq_df.head(10))

# Fetch meteorological data for the same period

FROM hourly_station_weather
WHERE datetime >= '2025-07-19 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-22 00:00:00'

""")

# Compute PM2.5 clearance (pre minus post)
